Match Preview

Al Ittihad host Al Wahda FC (UAE) at the Alinma Stadium in Jeddah in the AFC Champions League Elite Round of 16 — the most high-profile knockout tie of the West bracket. This match was originally scheduled for 10 March 2026 but was postponed and is now being played on 14 April. The delay has only amplified anticipation for a contest that pits Saudi Arabia's most decorated club against one of the UAE's strongest continental performers this season.

Al Ittihad enter the tie as heavy favourites — they finished 1st in the Saudi Pro League with 83 points (26W–5D–3L) and are considered one of the two or three best sides in Asia. Al Wahda, however, are no underdogs: they arrive having already beaten Ittihad 2–1 away in Jeddah just seven months ago (September 2025 group stage), proving they have the quality to cause an upset on the biggest continental stage. Elimination ends either club's Asian ambitions for the season — the stakes are absolute.

Head-to-Head (H2H)

Al Ittihad and Al Wahda have met 7 times in total — all in AFC continental competition. The overall record slightly favours Ittihad with 3 wins, against Al Wahda's 3 wins and 1 draw. However, recent history is decisively tilted towards the UAE side: Al Wahda are unbeaten in their last 3 meetings (2W–1D), including a stunning 4–1 away win in 2019 and a 2–1 win at Ittihad's own ground in September 2025. Ittihad's last win over Wahda dates back to 2010 — a remarkable stat that will provide enormous motivation for the Saudi giants to correct.

Team Form Analysis

Al Ittihad — Form & Strengths

Al Ittihad are the dominant force in Saudi football this season — Saudi Pro League champions with 83 points, conceding just 35 goals across a 34-game domestic campaign. Their attack, led by Aleksandar Mitrović (top scorer) and supported by Fabinho in midfield, is the most potent in the Saudi league. At home in Jeddah, Ittihad are virtually unstoppable domestically. The key vulnerability: the last three H2H meetings against Al Wahda have produced 0 wins — a psychological weight that will demand an immediate response in a knockout tie where there is no second chance.

Al Wahda — Form & Strengths

Al Wahda arrive as the genuine surprise package of the West Group — they finished 2nd with 13 points (4W–1D–0L), conceding just 4 goals across 5 group matches. Their recent domestic form shows mixed results (W–L–D–L–W over the last 5 UAE Pro League games), but continental competition brings out their best: they beat Ittihad in Jeddah last September, drew with Al Hilal, and defeated Shabab Al Ahli. Goalkeeper Mohamed Al Shamsi has been outstanding in keeping clean sheets, and their organized low defensive block is perfectly designed to frustrate even Saudi Pro League-level opposition.

Frequently Asked Questions

What time does Al Ittihad vs Al Wahda kick off?

The match kicks off at 18:00 UTC on 14 April 2026 — 21:00 Moscow time, 21:00 in Jeddah, and 22:00 in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

Where is the match being played?

The match takes place at Alinma Stadium in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia — the home ground of Al Ittihad Club.

What is the H2H record between Al Ittihad and Al Wahda?

In 7 all-time continental meetings: 3 wins each and 1 draw. Crucially, Al Wahda are unbeaten in the last 3 encounters (2W–1D) — Al Ittihad's last win over Wahda was back in 2010.

What stage is this match in the AFC Champions League Elite?

This is the Round of 16 of the AFC Champions League Elite 2025/26. It was originally scheduled for 10 March 2026 but was postponed to 14 April. The winner advances to the Quarter-Finals.

What is the prediction for Al Ittihad vs Al Wahda?

A narrow Al Ittihad win (2–1) is the most likely outcome given their superior squad depth and home advantage. Both teams to score (Yes) and Over 2.5 goals are recommended, given Al Wahda's counter-attacking threat and their ability to score against this Ittihad side — they did it in September 2025 (2–1 win away).
